name: Market Landscape
description: Size, growth, competitors and pricing in one market (Deep-Dive tier). Business research lane (research_profile: business, 2026-10-21). Same mission, citation-integrity gate, re-resolution manifest and approval chain as every other template; the evidence comes from web pages read and stored as snapshots (WEB ids), SEC filings (SEC ids), World Bank indicators (WB ids) and published research (DOIs). WEB re-resolution proves the bundle quotes exactly what was read from that URL at retrieval time, not that the page is still live or correct.

topic.description: The business question, in one or two sentences

competitors.description: Named competitors (one company name for SEC filings)

focus.description: Extra search words for the scout

analysis_focus.description: Extra search words for the analyst

country.description: ISO country code for macro indicators

pipeline.description_template: Quality gate: citation-density confidence (>= 0.6) plus >= 5 verified citations and per-section primary-source coverage; halts the run (PHASE30_QUALITY_BELOW_THRESHOLD) if the report is under-evidenced.
